{{Otheruses|Commander}}
[[File:WingCommanders2-CR.png|thumb|right|250px|Wing Commanders [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Gallia]], [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Tiin]] and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Fisto]] at the [[Battle of Lola Sayu/Legends|Battle of Lola Sayu]]]]
{{Quote|Charat Kraal, I am advancing you to the rank of wing commander. Your forces will be replenished to full fighting-wing status. You will perform special missions for me, often in association with the other fighting wings. |[[Czulkang Lah]] to [[Charat Kraal]]|<ref name="RebelDream">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines I: Rebel Dream]]''</ref>}}
'''Wing Commander''' was a [[Military rank/Legends|military rank]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of]] [[Galactic Republic/Legends|the Republic]],<ref name="Citadel Rescue">{{TCW|Citadel Rescue}}</ref> [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]],<ref name="Tschel">Lieutenant [[Tschel]] refers to a TIE Fighter wing commander in his briefing about the Obroa-skai raid.</ref> [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], and [[Yuuzhan Vong]]<ref name="RebelDream" /> militaries.

==Usage==
Although the full rank appears to be "wing commander," a person holding this rank was generally referred to simply as "commander."<ref name="HTTE">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref> In the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], the rank in Starfighter Command was used interchangeably with [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]].<ref name="RECG">''[[Rebellion Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
